name: owen-mods
description: Owen's Claude Code mods: a mod manager with a live web hub, a live logic graph of every mod, and Windows forks of hamzafer/claude-code-mods.

plugins.name: mod-hub
plugins.description: A bar above the prompt with your pinned commands and a prompt-cache countdown, /mod-manager to turn mods on and off and save presets of your setup, and /hub: a live web control room (mods, presets, logic graph, Mission Control). Ships the mod-setup skill for agents.

plugins.name: mod-logic
plugins.description: /mod-logic shows how every mod works: the events it hooks, the capabilities it calls (tagged by risk) and what it registers, as a live graph in 2D, and 3D in the Mod Hub.

plugins.name: blast-radius-win
plugins.description: Windows fork of blast-radius: holds risky Bash and PowerShell commands, shows what they would change, and fails closed.

plugins.name: mission-control-win
plugins.description: Windows fork of mission-control: /mission opens the live agent and tool-call map and a readable code map in the desktop app; ↗ Browser shows both full size in the Mod Hub.
